summary: Bug Fix: Blocked dates now correctly imported from iCal OTA sync with status='blocked'. Found and fixed a bug in process_ical_booking where status was hardcoded to 'confirmed' instead of using the parsed status from iCal. All blocked date features now working: import, display in calendar (gray), list view filter, manual booking validation, KPI exclusion.

minor.issue: Transient 520 errors from Cloudflare, but feed is actually created in DB. May need retry logic in frontend.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions when initializing - non-blocking

✅ OTA sync now imports blocked dates with status='blocked' and guest_name='Blocked'
✅ Manual booking creation on blocked dates returns 400 error with descriptive message
✅ Dashboard KPIs exclude blocked dates from revenue calculations (status != 'blocked')
✅ Analytics KPIs exclude blocked dates from revenue and booking counts
✅ Bookings calendar view shows blocked dates in gray (different from confirmed green)

updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Line 2146: Changed status='confirmed' to status=booking_data.get('status', 'confirmed') to preserve blocked status

bug_fix_details.original_issue: Blocked dates from iCal were imported but always set to status='confirmed' instead of status='blocked'
bug_fix_details.root_cause: In process_ical_booking() function (line 2146), the status was hardcoded to 'confirmed' when creating new bookings instead of using booking_data.get('status')
bug_fix_details.verification: Tested with real Airbnb iCal URL - now correctly imports 6 blocked dates with status='blocked'

context_for_next_testing_agent: Blocked dates bug fixed. The parse_ical_bookings function correctly parses 'Not available' entries as blocked, and process_ical_booking now preserves the status. All blocked date features verified working: calendar gray styling, list filter, manual booking validation, KPI exclusion.
